items.title: Jon Hendricks — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I’m not a singer. You guys are singers – you and Vic Damone, Mel Tormé, Joe Williams, and Billy Eckstine. You guys are the singers.

ctx.x: That’s beautiful. I can’t think of whom I remember singing that, but . . .
Billy Eckstine sang it. It’s a great song.
By age 11 you were performing on the radio. I have a quote that said that – it’s quoting you – it says, “I was a pro at age 11.”
